_meta.note: A queue, not a feed. Deal terms — price, consideration, deadline — come from reading the filing; nothing here scrapes them, because a wrong tender price is worse than no tender price. Form 4s ARE read: only transaction code P survives, keyed to the issuer, ranked by dollars committed.
